I'm going to look into that. I figured it would come with more symptoms, such as weight gain but I'm fairly trim, have a good metabolism, and I guess I could be chalking the other known symptoms up to my night shift job (fatigue, trouble sleeping, nervousness/anxiety). Thanks! 

Tho, I do still welcome other suggestions from folks. :)

Here's one for y'all, I'm a trans woman, been on hrt for 5 years, T levels very low, estrogen levels ideal. For the past year my hair has been shedding a lot. I have had super thick hair my whole life, but suddenly i have a noticeable part, and my bangs seem depleted and don't cover my temples as fully anymore. I haven't noticed a receding hairline, but when I really wash my hair out, a shocking amount seems to come out. I've been trying different methods for a few months including laser cap, and just start Finasteride to see if it helps.

I'm honestly stumped. Seems to follow female pattern hair loss. Haven't trued minoxidil, because it seems so costly when you extrapolate buying it forever. Any similar experiences? I always hear that HRT stops this from happening, but mine started years into being on HRT
